messages:
liam: FYI observed GPU provisioning failures in us-central1 this morning — cluster-autoscaler attempted to spin up 3 preemptible GPU nodes and got quota errors, ended up at 0/3 for the gpu-preemptible-1 pool. Pods backed off.

infra-bot: [alert] 1779354140 cluster-autoscaler: Failed to create instance: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project.

maria: ugh. do we have automatic cross-region fallback enabled? last time we relied on us-east1 as cold spare.

aj: not automatically. we have a manual routing policy and a DR script that can scale up us-east1. automated cross-region means networking + NLB changes and extra egress costs.

sree: short-term proposal: 1) mark a subset of inference deployments with a fallback nodeSelector to cpu-capable nodepools (smaller models) 2) enable a temporary dedicated non-preemptible GPU pool in us-east1 via infra script 3) add a soft-eviction policy so workers accept reduced qps rather than hard fail.

liam: can we implement 1) today? i want something that doesn't require cluster-wide LB changes.

maria: yes — we can push a deployment patch that adds nodeAffinity + tolerations and a NEW label 'fallback-durable: true'. app will try GPU nodes first, then CPU pool. example patch:```yaml
spec:
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        inference-tier: gold
    spec:
      affinity:
        nodeAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - weight: 100
              preference:
                matchExpressions:
                  - key: gpu
                    operator: In
                    values: ["true"]
      tolerations:
        - key: "fallback-durable"
          operator: "Exists"
```

aj: good. i also propose we raise the cluster-autoscaler max for the us-east1 nodepool to allow burst capacity while we bring up non-preemptibles. otherwise autoscaler will refuse to create enough nodes even if quota is available.

liam: what's the expected cost delta for switching 12 preemptible GPUs -> 6 non-preemptible in us-east1 for 4 hours? rough ballpark.

aj: ~ +$7k for 4 hours if we go non-preemptible N1 GPUs (including egress/overhead). preemptible would be cheaper but quotas blocked. can do a smaller footprint: spin 4 non-preemptible and fall back more to CPU model for lower qps.

sree: operational notes: - ensure nginx-ingress health checks tolerate increased latency across regions. - add an annotation to the rollout: "failover-mode: degraded-qps" so Ops knows these sessions are degraded by design. - update Canary to route 10% to fallback-first pods.

maria: i'm going to run the patch for deployments in the inference namespace now and set autoscaler max-instances for us-east1 to +10. will monitor.

liam: when you run the autoscaler change, please also push a temporary quota request to GCP support in parallel (raise GPUs in us-central1) — getting both channels going.

infra-bot: [action] 1779354290 Ticket created: GCP quota increase request #INC-4432.

aj: small extra thing — update our DR runbook with the exact kubectl commands so oncall can execute without manual edits. e.g.
```
# raise autoscaler max
gcloud container clusters update redwood-prod --region us-east1 --update-addons=ClusterAutoscaler --cluster-autoscaler-max-nodes=50
# patch deployment to add tolerance/affinity
kubectl patch deployment inference-worker -n inference --patch 'spec: ...'
```

sree: i also recommend adding a SchedulerPriority class so fallback pods have lower priority and we can gracefully preempt them back to GPU nodes when capacity returns.

maria: done with deployment patch, rolling update started. watch logs: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=inference-worker --tail=50`.

liam: thanks. i'll keep the thread updated. if GCP responds to the quota ticket fast, we can scale back in ~2-3 hours. otherwise we'll keep the fallback pattern as a standard mitigation. :thumbsup:

aj: can we add an alert rule: if autoscaler create failures for GPUs > 3 in 5m then trigger Runbook page + Slack pager? right now it's buried in cluster logs.

maria: yes adding alert to prometheus now.

infra-bot: [info] 1779354390 Monitoring: alert rule 'gpu_provision_failures' created."
